entities.name: Suniel
entities.description: A Selesnyan druid and woodshaper on Ravnica, member of the Conclave's council, responsible for creating Trostani.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The three-dryad unity of Cim, Oba and Ses, bonded to the trees of Ravnica and made guildmaster of Selesnya.

entities.name: Cim
entities.description: One of three sister dryads, the central figure who became part of Trostani.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: One of three sister dryads who merged into Trostani.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: One of three sister dryads who merged into Trostani.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Worldsoul of Selesnya, who spoke to the sisters and completed Suniel's spell.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Selesnya guild whose council of high priests Suniel sits on.

entities.name: Molander
entities.description: Fellow high priest on the council.

entities.name: Troslon
entities.description: Fellow high priest on the council.

entities.name: Alcarus
entities.description: Fellow high priest on the council.

entities.name: Sadruna
entities.description: Fellow high priest on the council.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Scheming dragon seen as a threat to Ravnica.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The World Tree where Selesnya gathered.

entities.name: Lattice of the Worldsoul
entities.description: The network of life through which the Worldsoul is reached.

events.summary: Suniel advises the dryad sisters to seek direct contact with the Worldsoul and devises a theory to bind them to a tree.
events.quote: He advised them to try to achieve direct contact with the Worldsoul

events.summary: Suniel binds the sisters' essence within a tree and they reach the Worldsoul, who commands them to grow an army.
events.quote: Suniel bound their essence within a tree

events.summary: Mat'Selesnya completes the spell, bonding the dryads to all trees of Ravnica; Suniel cannot save them.
events.quote: watch helplessly as the three sisters disappeared into the oaks

events.summary: The three dryads materialize in Vitu-Ghazi as Trostani, the new guildmaster, and Suniel realizes Cim is gone.
events.quote: The three who are one told the high priests that they were now Trostani

relations.quote: is famous for having been directly responsible for the creation of the three- dryad unity known as Trostani

relations.note: Sits on its council of high priests.
relations.quote: He sits on the council of high priests of the Conclave
Suniel was close to the three sister dryads
